zeros = []
for r in range(len(grid)):
    for c in range(len(grid[0])):
        if grid[r][c] == 0:
            zeros.append((r, c))

print("Positions of 0s:")
print(zeros)
print(f"Total zeros: {len(zeros)}")

# Check if they form any patterns
import numpy as np
arr = np.array(grid)
print(f"\nGrid shape: {arr.shape}")
print(f"Unique values: {np.unique(arr)}")
